facts.text: The hotel occupies the reimagined 1915 Austrian Monarchy Bank building.
facts.excerpt: the Golden Quarter hotel occupies the reimagined 1915 Austrian Monarchy Bank

facts.text: The Arany Spa is set in the former vault of the bank building.
facts.excerpt: the former vault has been transformed into the Arany Spa

facts.text: Gold-bar-shaped tiles line the spa's swimming pool.
facts.excerpt: where gold-bar-shaped tiles line the nearly 50-foot-long swimming pool

facts.text: The Bank Brasserie & Bar is housed in the former central cashier hall.
facts.excerpt: The central cashier hall now houses the Bank Brasserie & Bar

facts.text: Wall decorations are inspired by brooches designed by Art Nouveau artist Carl Otto Czeschka.
facts.excerpt: maximalist wall decorations inspired by blown-up brooches originally designed by Art Nouveau artist Carl Otto Czeschka

facts.text: Every room features elements of wood, marble and mother-of-pearl.
facts.excerpt: Elements of wood, marble and mother-of-pearl welcome you in every room.

facts.text: Bathrooms are marble, with a separate bathtub, rain shower and heated floors.
facts.excerpt: Relax in a spacious marble bathroom with separate bathtub and rain shower, heated floors and exclusive amenities.

facts.text: The Grand Salon ballroom is where bank directors of the Laenderbank once conducted negotiations.
facts.excerpt: Where once bank directors of the Länderbank conducted negotiations, today all types of events can be held within this historic space.

facts.text: The Golden Quarter luxury shopping district is steps from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Shop in the most luxurious boutiques at the exclusive Golden Quarter (Goldenes Quartier), only steps away from the hotel

facts.text: The hotel's address is Am Hof 2 in Vienna's 1st district.
facts.excerpt: Am Hof 2, 1010 Vienna, Austria

facts.text: The Bank Brasserie has an open show kitchen where diners can watch the chefs.
facts.excerpt: The open show kitchen allows diners to watch and follow the chefs preparing delicious menus using high-quality products.

facts.text: From May to October the outdoor terrace becomes the Bollicafe, in collaboration with Champagne Bollinger.
facts.excerpt: From May to October, the elegant outdoor terrace of Park Hyatt Vienna transforms into the Bollicafé in collaboration with Champagne Bollinger and KATE & KON

facts.text: The weekend brunch is not available in July and August.
facts.excerpt: Not available in July and August.

facts.text: Cafe Am Hof sells cakes, chocolates and tartes made by the team of Chef Patissier Oliver Ivanschits.
facts.excerpt: The display is filled with delicious cakes, chocolates and tartes lovingly prepared by the team around Chef Patissier Oliver Ivanschits.

facts.text: The Rossano Ferretti Hairspa is located in the hotel's former Living Room.
facts.excerpt: The Rossano Ferretti Hairspa is located at the former Living Room of Park Hyatt Vienna

facts.text: The two-level Royal Penthouse Suite has a private elevator and four terraces.
facts.excerpt: This sophisticated escape is complete with a cutting-edge gym, private elevator and four expansive terraces

facts.text: Children under 16 may use the spa when accompanied by an adult, from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m.
facts.excerpt: Children under the age of 16 are welcome when accompanied by an adult from 11 a.m.–6 p.m. daily.

facts.text: Dogs receive a Very Important Dog service with treats, a dog bed and a bowl.
facts.excerpt: we offer our Very Important Dog service, which includes dog treats upon arrival, a comfortable dog bed for the night and a dog bowl.

facts.text: Self-parking is in the public Am Hof car park in front of the hotel, with direct access into the lobby.
facts.excerpt: There’s direct access from the garage through a side entrance into the hotel lobby.

facts.text: The Am Hof car park has a height restriction of 2.05 metres.
facts.excerpt: The car park has a height restriction of 2.05 metres.

facts.text: The building is a sandstone structure with columns and carved embellishments.
facts.excerpt: an imposing sandstone structure with columns and carved embellishments

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler listed the hotel on its Hot List 2015 and Readers' Choice Awards in several years.
The hotel has 146 rooms including 42 suites.
facts.excerpt: our luxurious 146 guestrooms, including 42 suites

contradictions.note: p2 says 146 guestrooms; p7 header lists Rooms 143 (p7 body also says 146)
